inputTimeline.timingKind: Ordered actions with requested wall-clock waits; screenshots and browser scheduling add variable elapsed time. Per-action timestamps were not sampled.
attackSteps: Navigate to isolated app; tap Start practice; wait for bout status (maximum 40 seconds).
Capture initial portrait; sample opponent list and local/session storage plus service-worker controller.
Sample initial HUD/status; hold keyboard W for 1200 ms then release; capture approach portrait and sample HUD/status.
Wait 4000 ms; capture attack-close portrait; sample HUD/status.
Tap .ws-touch-attack twelve times, with 350 ms wait after each tap; sample HUD/status and capture local-reward portrait.
Hold W for 700 ms then release; wait 1000 ms; sample HUD/status.
Tap Retry; immediately sample HUD/status (this immediate HUD sample can precede repaint).
Wait 1000 ms; capture retry portrait; close browser and server.
inflate110Steps: Navigate and start; capture initial portrait; sample opponent/storage; wait 1000 ms; capture later portrait; close.
